title: 낙동강수계관리위원회규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:17698:20020808:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Organization of the Ministry of Environment and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 17698, August 8, 2002>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>
Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.
Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (4) Omitted.
(5) Part of the Regulations on the Nakdong River Basin Management Committee shall be amended as follows:
In the main sentence of Article 6 (3), "Head of the Nakdong River Environmental Management Office" shall be replaced with "Head of the Nakdong River Basin Environmental Office," and subparagraph 1 of the same paragraph shall read:
1. Head of the Daegu Regional Environmental Office.
In Article 7 (2) 1 and paragraph (3) of the same Article, "Nakdong River Environmental Management Office" shall each be replaced with "Nakdong River Basin Environmental Office."
(6) through (37) Omitted.
Article 5 Omitted.
